Let
\[
U=P_1,\qquad V=P_2,\qquad W=P_3,\qquad T=P_4.
\]
Then
\[
X_i\sim (U,V,W+T),\qquad Y_i\sim (U,W,V+T),
\]
conditionally independently given \((U,V,W,T)\).

The arrangements of symbols inside each sample carry no extra mutual information once the count vectors are known, so
\[
I(X_1^n;Y_1^n)=I(N_X;N_Y),
\]
where \(N_X\) and \(N_Y\) are the multinomial count vectors.

I will use the standard Laplace entropy expansion for a regular Bayesian multinomial experiment: if a \(d\)-dimensional parameter \(\theta\) has prior density \(\pi\), Fisher information matrix \(J(\theta)\), and one observes \(n\) iid samples, then
\[
I(\theta;Z^n)
=
\frac d2\log n
+h(\pi)
+\frac12\mathbb E_\pi\log\det J(\theta)
-\frac d2\log(2\pi e)
+o(1).
\]
Here this applies for every \(a>0\); the Dirichlet boundary singularities are integrable and contribute only \(o(1)\).

Since \(X^n\) and \(Y^n\) are conditionally independent given \(P\),
\[
I(X^n;Y^n)
=
I(P;X^n)+I(P;Y^n)-I(P;(X^n,Y^n)).
\]

The \(X\)-experiment depends only on
\[
(U,V,1-U-V)\sim \operatorname{Dirichlet}(a,1,2),
\]
and similarly for \(Y\). Its dimension is \(2\), prior entropy is
\[
h_X=\log\frac{\Gamma(a)}{\Gamma(a+3)}
+a\psi(a+3)-(a-1)\psi(a)-\psi(2),
\]
and the multinomial Fisher determinant is
\[
\det J_X=\frac1{UV(1-U-V)}.
\]
Thus
\[
\mathbb E\log\det J_X
=
3\psi(a+3)-\psi(a)-\psi(1)-\psi(2).
\]

For the joint experiment the full parameter is
\[
(U,V,W,T)\sim \operatorname{Dirichlet}(a,1,1,1),
\]
with dimension \(3\) and entropy
\[
h_P=
\log\frac{\Gamma(a)}{\Gamma(a+3)}
+(a-1)\bigl(\psi(a+3)-\psi(a)\bigr).
\]
The joint Fisher matrix for \((U,V,W)\) has determinant
\[
\det J_{XY}
=
\frac{2(1-U)}
{U\,V\,W\,(W+T)(V+T)}.
\]
Therefore
\[
\mathbb E\log\det J_{XY}
=
\log 2+\psi(3)-\psi(a)-2\psi(1)-2\psi(2)+4\psi(a+3).
\]

Putting the three entropy expansions together,
\[
I(X^n;Y^n)
=
\frac12\log n+C(a)+o(1),
\]
where
\[
\begin{aligned}
C(a)
&=
2h_X-h_P+\mathbb E\log\det J_X
-\frac12\mathbb E\log\det J_{XY}
-\frac12\log(2\pi e)\\
&=
\log\frac{\Gamma(a)}{\Gamma(a+3)}
+(a+2)\psi(a+3)
-\left(a-\frac12\right)\psi(a)
-2\psi(2)-\frac12\psi(3)
-\frac12\log(4\pi e).
\end{aligned}
\]

Hence the required limit is

\[
\boxed{
\log\frac{\Gamma(a)}{\Gamma(a+3)}
+(a+2)\psi(a+3)
-\left(a-\frac12\right)\psi(a)
-2\psi(2)-\frac12\psi(3)
-\frac12\log(4\pi e)
}.
\]
